description: This Java source file defines the Util class, which provides static utility methods for creating OpenTracing spans to trace service execution, specifically within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes methods for creating spans with tagging based on tenant and device IDs and is used for facilitating distributed tracing in service operations.

classes.name: Util
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for creating and managing OpenTracing spans for tracing service operations in Eclipse Hono.

methods.name: newChildSpan
methods.description: Creates a new OpenTracing span with specified operation name, span context, tracer, tenant ID, device ID, and class name, adding appropriate tags for tracing purposes. It supports two overloads, one with tenant and device IDs, and another with only tenant ID.
parameters: operationName: The name of the operation for which the span is created.
spanContext: Existing span context for parent span reference.
tracer: The Tracer instance used to create the span.
deviceId: The device identifier (nullable, used in the first method).
className: The name of the class to include in span tags.

search-terms: span creation with tenant and device tags
